package_note: Extracted from a single multi-sign permit/shop package. One source file yields multiple records. In production each array element below is stored as its own record file; they are grouped here only for review.

shared_context.note: All four signs share the Indect AK 4-Digit 130 counter (comp-indect-ak4d130), referenced once, reused four times.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A single-faced, internally lit cabinet that lists each parking level and shows a live count of open spaces per level on green LED displays, with the current level highlighted. Drivers read total availability before committing to a level.
knowledge.rationale: Backlit translucent face keeps the static level labels bright at night, while the graphics are knocked out behind each counter so the LED digits read cleanly through their own windows.

structure.construction: SignComp #1927 8in deep single-faced extruded aluminum cabinet, 1-3/4in retainers, fully welded

face.decoration: translucent vinyl applied first-surface; graphics knocked out to create a window for each counter

structure.fabrication_method: backlit cabinet with reverse-weeded counter windows

structure.construction: Indect AK 4-Digit 130, mounted in cabinet on custom aluminum brackets, qty 6 (one per level)

materials_manifest.product: Matthews MP02110 Cook Islands Blue, anti-graffiti gloss clear

rules_observations: Current-level highlight (reverse field on the active row) gives an immediate you-are-here read.
craft_observations: Knocking the face graphics out behind each counter integrates the digital units into the layout instead of bolting them on top.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A roadside post-mounted panel that directs drivers toward a terminal and garage and shows a single live space count, built non-illuminated with reflective films and a breakaway post for roadside safety.
knowledge.rationale: Reflective vinyl carries legibility at night from headlights without internal power, and the TXDOT slipbase lets the post shear away safely on vehicle impact.

structure.construction: 1/4in aluminum, bolted to main panel with aluminum tie plates
1/4in aluminum, bolted to 2-1/2in x 3in extruded aluminum windbeam
10 BWG steel tube post, capped/welded ends, TXDOT-approved triangular slipbase, bolted to poured footings

materials_manifest.product: Matthews RAL1023 Traffic Yellow, anti-graffiti gloss clear
3M 4090DG3 digital print PMS 287C, luster UV overlaminate
3M 4090DG3 digital print PMS 124C, luster UV overlaminate

rules_observations: Clearance height broken out into its own high-contrast yellow panel above the blue field, the standard hierarchy for overhead-clearance warnings.

records.variant_note: Drawing set includes per-level variants (Level A, Level C) that differ only in the level letter; treated as one design family.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A wall-mounted garage entrance treatment combining fabricated dimensional letters (TERMINAL / GARAGE C), a logo, a small cabinet showing gate range and a live rate display, and a suspended chevron-striped clearance bar.
knowledge.rationale: Dimensional fabricated letters give depth and shadow on the wall for a premium architectural read, while the separate cabinet isolates the dynamic rate/count content for service.

structure.construction: 0.090in aluminum faces, welded 2in deep 0.063in returns, removable backs, 3/4in x 2in aluminum bar stock bottom bar; clamped to mesh panels with countersunk screws
0.125in aluminum face, 2in deep returns; CNC-cut 1/4in aluminum C letter, flush-stud mounted to logo panel
SignComp K1602/32 6in deep single-faced hinge-body extruded aluminum cabinet, welded; 1/8in aluminum face; flush wall mount
8in O.D. PVC tube, capped ends, surface-applied reflective chevron, suspended on stainless cable

materials_manifest.product: Matthews RAL1023 Traffic Yellow, anti-graffiti gloss clear
Matthews MP02110 Cook Islands Blue, anti-graffiti gloss clear

craft_observations: Fabricated returns with removable backs allow service access while keeping clean faces; this is the construction choice that separates a fabricated letter from a flat cut panel.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A double-sided sign hung from the parking structure ceiling that points drivers toward 1-hour parking and shows a live space count, readable from both directions of travel.
knowledge.rationale: Back-to-back cabinets on a single hanging frame serve both approach directions; reflective film carries legibility under garage lighting without internal power.

structure.construction: fabricated 1-1/2in x 1-1/2in x 3/16in aluminum square tube frame with ceiling-mounting brackets; mechanically fastened to existing post-tensioned concrete ceiling
structure.install_caution: verify hardware and placement with structural review and GPR/X-ray of post-tensioned slab

structure.construction: 2in x 2in x 1/4in aluminum angle inner frame inside a 3in x 3in x 1/4in hatbox-style outer frame; 1/8in aluminum face bonded with Lord's epoxy; bolted back-to-back

open_items: Ceiling attachment hardware and placement pending structural review and GPR/X-ray of post-tensioned slab

rules_observations: Mirrored face layout (arrow and content reversed face to face) keeps the directional read correct from both travel directions.
